Products and Services
Welcome to Inco Grain, Ltd., your premier destination for top-tier corn and soybean handling in Goodland, Indiana, and neighboring communities. With a commitment to precision, community support, and agricultural excellence, Inco Grain is your trusted partner for contributing to the success of our agricultural landscape.
Corn
Our corn capacity is 1,800,000 bushels.
Soybeans
Our soybean capacity is 2,000,000 bushels.
Grain Elevator Information
Up to date announcements regarding operations at Inco Grain, Ltd.
REMINDER
We operate on Central time. Please call the office at 219-233-5975 if you have any questions.
Harvest Hours
With harvest in full swing, we have adjusted our hours. We will be open Monday to Friday from 7am to 7pm. Weekend hours will be updated as they become available. Hours are subject to change.
Harvest Lunch - October 13th
Heritage FS will be serving lunch for anyone hauling into Inco Grain on Tuesday, October 13th from 11:30am to 1:30pm. Meals will consist of pork burgers, chips, cookies, and water. Thank you, Heritage FS!
